body_html:
Fashion comes forward with the Global Moda 6960 guest chair, designed by Sava Cvek. A polished aluminum frame, molded polypropylene shell, and curated leg and armcap finishes make it a confident choice for reception areas, private offices, and casual meeting spaces. It is one of the more design-led office chairs for waiting room and lobby settings you will find at this price.

Features

  • Contemporary Sava Cvek silhouette that elevates any guest-welcoming area
  • Molded polypropylene shell in three colours — Night, Cloud, and Shadow — that wipes clean
  • Polished aluminum four-leg frame offered in six woodgrain-texture leg finishes
  • Armcap options: upholstered textile to match your fabric, impact-resistant high-gloss or woodgrain plastic, or SSU
  • Wide selection of upholstery textiles for the seat
  • Tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards for commercial use

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 25"W x 25"D x 31"H with a rated capacity of 300 lbs. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty on frame and components, 12 years on control mechanisms, with 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

Family-owned since 1964 and based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Moda 6960, or call 1-800-835-9565.
